screen_names_and_descriptions: -1659243725 - Start state: This is the start state of the app with no visible UI information provided. No user-facing elements or actions are described for this screen.

-1865291420 - TokenList: This screen shows the Android Token title bar and a More options button in the action bar. The main content area displays an empty token list with the message No Tokens Defined. From here, the user can view that no tokens are currently available and access additional actions through More options.

-1331436002 - TokenList: This screen displays a popup-style options list for token management. The visible menu items are Add Token, Change PIN, Remove Pin, Delete Token, and Scan QR. The user can select one of these actions to manage tokens or PIN settings.

1551361471 - PinRemove(Window=Main): This screen is used to remove an existing PIN from the app. It shows the Android Token title, a label reading Enter Existing PIN, an input field for the current PIN, and a REMOVE button. The user can enter the current PIN and submit it to remove PIN protection.
-2142752532 - End state: This is the end state of the app flow with no visible UI information provided. No user-facing elements or actions are described for this screen.

1589344295 - PinChange(Window=Main): This screen allows the user to change the current PIN. It includes fields labeled Enter Existing PIN, New PIN, and Confirm PIN, each paired with an input box, plus a SAVE button. The user can enter the old PIN, type and confirm a new PIN, and save the change.

-277241117 - TokenList(Window=Main): This screen shows a selection dialog titled Android Token. The dialog contains a list with a selectable item labeled h and two buttons, CANCEL and OK. The user can choose the listed item and then confirm or dismiss the dialog.

-872261461 - TokenAdd: This is the first step of adding a token. It includes fields for Token Type, Name, Serial No, and OTP Length, with spinners showing Event Token and 6 as current selections, plus a NEXT > button. The user can enter token details, choose token settings, and proceed to the next step.

1796820486 - TokenAdd: This is the second step of adding a token. It shows Token Seed Method with radio button choices Direct Seed Entry, Generate Random Seed, and Seed from Password, followed by a Token Seed Value input, a format spinner showing Base 32, and a COMPLETE button. The user can choose how the seed is provided, enter the seed value, select its format, and finish token creation.

1457469927 - TokenAdd(Window=Popup Menu): This popup menu lets the user choose a token seed format. The available options are Hex, Base 32, and Base 64. The user can select one of these formats for the token seed value.

1145703961 - TokenAdd: This screen shows a confirmation dialog warning that the token seed is weak. The message says the recommended minimum is 128 bits and that the entered seed contains 80 bits, then asks whether to create the token anyway. The user can choose CANCEL to stop or OK to continue creating the token.
83870192 - TokenAdd(Window=Popup Menu): This popup menu shows selectable OTP length options. The visible choices are 6, 7, and 8. The user can pick the desired OTP length for the token.
2051260844 - TokenAdd: This screen displays a popup list of OTP length values. The available options are 6, 7, and 8. The user can select one of these values for the token configuration.

1983117377 - TokenAdd: This screen displays a popup list for choosing the token type. The available options are Event Token and Time Token. The user can select the token type to use during token setup.
